scope.text: Calculus; real-valued functions continuous on a closed interval [a,b]

text: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus is a theorem in calculus with two parts connecting differentiation and integration: Part 1 shows that the definite integral function is an antiderivative, and Part 2 (the evaluation theorem) evaluates a definite integral using any antiderivative.
